name: io.github.docsagent/docsagent
description: DocsAgent gives AI agents instant, private access to your personal knowledge base. Zotero is the first supported source: search, read, and write a local Zotero library through a resident native C++ search engine - BM25 full-text search, query-ranked passage retrieval, metadata and citations, and gated write tools (import by DOI/arXiv, notes, batch modify). All local-first: the library never leaves the machine. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, and Qwen Code.
